publicMeasurement.principle: Publication is not validation of distribution. Treat stranger usage, paid events, repeat use, feedback, quality scoring, and discoverability as the next reality evidence before speculative expansion outranks live-Fruit learning.

monetization.pricingReason: Private Apify calibration showed the intended PASS/RISK/FAIL behavior at 256 MB with a three-URL run cost displayed as $0.000; $0.005 per observed URL leaves substantial platform-cost headroom while remaining suitable for bulk automation.

economicFrequencyAssessment.coreInsight: Low-ticket passive Fruit requires both a nutrient channel and enough throughput. A marketplace listing can solve fulfillment without solving acquisition frequency. Meaningful revenue at $0.005 per observed URL likely requires recurring CI, CMS, sitemap, monitoring, or agent workflows rather than isolated manual checks.
preferredMutationDirection: CI/deploy guard that checks changed or published URLs automatically
scheduled sitemap or site-page preview monitoring
CMS publish hook or automation-template integration
agent/MCP invocation where audits occur as a step in publishing workflows

marketReality2026_08_29.observation: Comparable Open Graph/social-preview Actors visible in Apify search currently show very low total/monthly user counts despite prices spanning free or usage-only through $1, $20, and much higher per 1,000 audits. This weakens the hypothesis that Apify Store traffic alone will produce meaningful volume quickly.
marketReality2026_08_29.interpretation: The category appears real but low-throughput inside Apify. Price is not the dominant current bottleneck; recurring use and distribution surface density are more important.
marketReality2026_08_29.doNotInfer: No stranger usage during the first day is not evidence that the product itself is unwanted; fresh indexing and quality data are still pending.
